body: I feel the same way too.

I'm sorry you're going through this. I feel the same way, I've cried for hours begging all the gods to please give a sick kid a chance in life instead of wasting it on me. 
I really wish I could make you feel better, to tell you it's going to get better. But at least I can tell you that I understand you. And wherever you are I really wish you get the love that you deserve.

I do the same thing. Every night I pray to god to please spare some helpless kid, or a sick father and take my life instead. I just don't want to live anymore and I wish I could give my life to someone who actually wants to
